treatment_summary: The plan aligns the patient’s regimen with NICE CG126/NG185 for secondary‑prevention of coronary artery disease, NG136 for hypertension in CKD, and NG106 for fluid management. Aspirin is continued lifelong; prasugrel is stopped and replaced by clopidogrel only if the 12‑month DAPT window has not yet elapsed. Simvastatin is switched to high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg to meet the ≥40 % non‑HDL‑C reduction target. Metoprolol is up‑titrated, amlodipine increased to 5 mg, and the existing ARB/HCTZ combo is maintained with close potassium monitoring. A loop diuretic (furosemide) is added for volume control, and a potassium binder is available to manage hyperkalaemia from RAAS blockade. All drug choices respect renal dosing, avoid contraindicated agents, and include monitoring intervals per NICE guidance.
